Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
Please let me have the rest of the [Primer](/book/353) I thought I had it all, but I cannot find further than what I send.
I am waiting for [Mr Freeman](/person/523)’s orders before I send back [the French history](/book/99)

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
